script_skip_tensor_list: apply a boolean mask to filter a list of PyTorch tensors by selected indices
script_skip_tensor: apply a boolean mask to filter a single PyTorch tensor by selected indices
expand_2d_or_3d_tensor: expand a 2D or 3D PyTorch tensor along dimension 1 with a padding index
coalesce: return the first non-None PyTorch tensor from two optional tensor arguments
fill_tensors: fill masked positions in a 2D or 3D tensor with values from another tensor
